problem: ns-gm is the runtime execution tool that can execute arbitrary SuiteScript in NetSuite. The ticket envisions using ns-gm for creating records in sandbox (via record.create, search.create, etc.) and for verifying deployed customizations. Currently ns-gm has no SDF awareness and no concept of object creation workflows — it only executes ad-hoc code and retrieves logs.

files.why: The deployed RESTlet that executes SuiteScript code. Lines 63-96: module map with 24+ N/* modules including record, search, query, file, task. Lines 114-125: dynamic module injection. This is the execution boundary — any SuiteScript that can be written can be executed here.
CLI entry point with Commander.js. Registers 8 commands: init, run, env, logs, stop, setup, setup:ci, help. No SDF or deployment-related commands exist.
Execute SuiteScript command — sends code to proxy which forwards to RESTlet. This is how record.create, search.create, etc. would be invoked for sandbox object creation.
Log retrieval via SuiteQL query on scriptnote table. Supports script-id filtering — useful for verifying deployed scripts are executing.
Express proxy with /run and /logs endpoints. Currently a pass-through to RESTlet. No batch/workflow execution support.
OAuth 2.0 M2M authentication with JWT (PS256). Token caching with 55-min TTL. Auto-refresh on 401. This is the auth layer for all ns-gm operations.
Credential storage at ~/.ns-gm/credentials.json. Alias-based profiles for multiple accounts/environments.
Non-interactive CI setup used by helix-global-server orchestrator (runNsGmSetupAndValidateEnv). Sets up credentials without user interaction.
Default config: proxy port 9292, inactivity timeout 900000ms, default log count 20.
Version 1.0.5, Node.js >=24.0.0, bin: ns-gm. No test framework, no build step (plain JS). Dependencies: commander, express, jose, axios.
AI agent guidance. Documents architecture, credential model, command surface, active files.

facts: ns-gm RESTlet provides access to 24+ N/* modules: log, search, record, runtime, format, query, transaction, file, https, http, email, error, url, encode, crypto, currency, render, xml, config, task, redirect, cache, certificateControl, workflow
Arbitrary SuiteScript can be executed via ns-gm run --code or --file, including record.create(), search.create(), query.runSuiteQL(), file.create(), etc.
The RESTlet uses new Function() for code execution within a module scope
ns-gm has no SDF/SuiteCloud CLI integration — it operates purely through RESTlet-based SuiteScript execution
The helix-global-server orchestrator sets up ns-gm via setup:ci with alias 'helix-runtime' and validates environment with ns-gm env
No test files or test framework exist in the repo
The proxy server runs detached on localhost:9292 with 15-minute inactivity timeout
OAuth tokens are cached with 60-second refresh buffer before expiry
ns-gm is installed globally in sandbox runtime via npm install -g (orchestrator sandbox-runtime.ts)
